summary.en: Growth, doping and characterization of bulk and epitaxial semiconductor materials.
summary.fr: Croissance, dopage et caractérisation de matériaux semi-conducteurs massifs et épitaxiaux.
summary.ar: نمو وتطعيم وتوصيف المواد شبه الموصلة الكتلية والوبائية.

description: [ADD CONTENT] Describe the group's work on semiconductor material growth (e.g. MOCVD, MBE), doping strategies, defect engineering and structural/optical/electrical characterization techniques used to evaluate material quality.
objectives: Understand growth-structure-property relationships in compound semiconductors
Reduce defect density in epitaxial layers
Develop reliable doping and passivation strategies

summary.en: Design, fabrication and characterization of III-V compound semiconductor devices.
summary.fr: Conception, fabrication et caractérisation de dispositifs à base de semi-conducteurs III-V.

description: [ADD CONTENT] Describe device architectures studied (HEMTs, HBTs, laser diodes), fabrication process flow, and key performance metrics targeted (breakdown voltage, mobility, efficiency).

summary.en: Modelling and characterization of thin-film and next-generation solar cells.
summary.fr: Modélisation et caractérisation de cellules solaires en couches minces et de nouvelle génération.
summary.ar: نمذجة وتوصيف الخلايا الشمسية الرقيقة ومن الجيل الجديد.

description: [ADD CONTENT] Describe solar cell architectures under study (thin-film, tandem, perovskite), simulation tools used (SCAPS-1D) and efficiency/stability targets.
objectives: Increase power conversion efficiency of thin-film absorbers
Model loss mechanisms in multi-junction cells
Improve long-term stability under illumination

summary.en: Integrated photonic devices and light-matter interaction in semiconductor nanostructures.
summary.fr: Dispositifs photoniques intégrés et interaction lumière-matière dans les nanostructures semi-conductrices.
summary.ar: المكونات الفوتونية المتكاملة وتفاعل الضوء مع المادة في البنى النانوية شبه الموصلة.

description: [ADD CONTENT] Describe photonic device work (waveguides, resonators, LEDs, lasers) and optical characterization capabilities.
objectives: Design low-loss waveguide structures
Study light emission efficiency in nanostructured materials
Develop integrated photonic building blocks

summary.en: Quantum-confined structures and devices for sensing and information applications.
summary.fr: Structures et dispositifs à confinement quantique pour la détection et l'information quantique.

description: [ADD CONTENT] Describe quantum well/dot structures studied and target applications (single-photon sources, sensors, qubits).
objectives: Engineer quantum-confined structures with tailored emission

summary.en: Nanostructuring and nanoscale characterization of functional materials.
summary.fr: Nanostructuration et caractérisation à l'échelle nanométrique de matériaux fonctionnels.

description: [ADD CONTENT] Describe nanofabrication capabilities (lithography, etching) and nanoscale characterization tools (AFM, TEM).
objectives: Develop reproducible nanopatterning processes

summary.en: Data-driven and machine-learning methods applied to materials and device design.
summary.fr: Méthodes de science des données et d'apprentissage automatique appliquées aux matériaux et à la conception de dispositifs.
